# ui::ClipboardContent

Header: `winui/ui/Clipboard.hpp`.

What to put on the clipboard. Every part that is set goes on it together, in one operation, and an app pasting picks the format it understands.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ClipboardContent content;
content.text                = "report.pdf";
content.storage_items       = {"C:/Reports/report.pdf"};
content.requested_operation = ui::DataPackageOperation::Move; // a cut
ui::clipboard().set_content(content, {.is_allowed_in_history = false});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::optional<std::string>` |  | UTF-8 text, or nullopt to put no text on the clipboard. |
| `bitmap` | `std::optional<Bitmap>` |  | A picture (straight-alpha RGBA), or nullopt for none. |
| `storage_items` | `std::vector<std::filesystem::path>` |  | File-system paths of files or folders. |
| `requested_operation` | `DataPackageOperation` | `DataPackageOperation::Copy` | The operation requested of whoever pastes the storage items (a file manager copies or moves them accordingly). |
